column1: # Conversion period measured with {"command":"probe_period"} on firmware
# The nominal integration time is a LABEL: the VEML7700 datasheet (Rev. 1.0
# doc 84286) shows an internal oscillator in its block diagram and publishes
# no tolerance for it in the Basic Characteristics table. Measured here the
# period is 1.09x its label in every slot -- a fixed scale error
# These runs carry no temperature column: soc_temp_c was added in v5.0.
# The v5.0 temperature sweep supersedes them for any temperature question.
